description: This file contains Go source code implementing functions to recursively resolve schema references in Kubernetes OpenAPI schemas, including handling circular references and schema properties.

methods.name: PopulateRefs
methods.description: Recursively replaces references in a schema with the referred schemas, avoiding mutation of the original schema.

methods.name: populateRefs
methods.description: Helper function that performs the recursive reference resolution within a schema, handling circular references and nested properties.

methods.name: refOf
methods.description: Extracts the reference string from a schema if it is a reference, including handling wrapped references in allOf.
